description_en: Queries the details of Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的详情列表
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of instances per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含实例的数量。取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的IP地址
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The remark of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的备注。支持模糊查询
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The mitigation plan edition of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query. Valid values:

0: Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland) Insurance edition.
1: Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland) Unlimited edition.
2: Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland) acceleration line.
9: Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium (the Chinese mainland) Professional Edition
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的防护套餐版本。取值：

0：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）保险版。
1：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）无忧版。
2： 表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）加速线路。
9：表示DDoS高防（中国内地）专业版
parameters.name: edition

parameters.help_en:
The service traffic forwarding status of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query. Valid values:

0: Service traffic forwarding is stopped.
1: Service traffic forwarding is normal
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的业务流量转发状态。取值：

0：表示已停止转发业务流量。
1：表示正常转发业务流量
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The earliest expiration time of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query. This means that only instances whose expiration time is later than the value of ExpireStartTime are queried. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的最早到期时间（即查询到期时间在ExpireStartTime之后的DDoS高防实例）。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: expire_start_time

parameters.help_en: The latest expiration time of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query. This means that only instances whose expiration time is earlier than the value of ExpireEndTime are queried. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的最晚到期时间（即查询到期时间在ExpireEndTime之前的DDoS高防实例）。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: expire_end_time

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query. You can specify up to 200 Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表。最多可配置200个DDoS高防实例
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The statuses of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query. You can specify up to 2 Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance statuses
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的状态列表。最多可配置2个DDoS高防实例状态
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en:
The tag key attached to the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query. Maximum value of N: 200, which means you can specify up to 200 tag keys. The configuration rules are as follows:

Each tag consists of a tag key (Key) and a tag value (Value), separated by a comma (,).
Tags are separated by commas (,).

The tag key (Key) and tag value (Value) must appear in pairs
fields.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例绑定的标签键。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个标签键。配置规则如下：

每个标签包含一个标签键（Key）和一个标签值（Value），中间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
标签之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

标签键（Key）和标签值（Value）必须成对出现
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value attached to the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query. Maximum value of N: 200, which means you can specify up to 200 tag values. The configuration rules are as follows:

Each tag consists of a tag key (Key) and a tag value (Value), separated by a comma (,).
Tags are separated by commas (,).

The tag key (Key) and tag value (Value) must appear in pairs
fields.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例绑定的标签值。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个标签值。配置规则如下：

每个标签包含一个标签键（Key）和一个标签值（Value），中间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
标签之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

标签键（Key）和标签值（Value）必须成对出现
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags attached to the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例绑定的标签列表
parameters.name: tag

Instances.description_en: The details of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 实例的创建时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

DebtStatus.description_en: The overdue payment status of the instance. The value is fixed as 0, which indicates no overdue payments, because Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium currently only supports the subscription billing method
DebtStatus.description_zh: 实例的欠费状态。取值固定为0，表示不欠费，因为DDoS高防服务目前只支持包年包月的预付费计费方式

Edition.description_en:
The mitigation plan edition of the instance. Valid values:

0: Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland) Insurance edition.
1: Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland) Unlimited edition.
2: Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium (outside the Chinese mainland) acceleration line.
9: Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium (the Chinese mainland) Professional Edition
Edition.description_zh:
实例的防护套餐版本。取值：

0：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）保险版。
1：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）无忧版。
2： 表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）加速线路。
9：表示DDoS高防（中国内地）专业版

Enabled.description_en:
The service traffic forwarding status of the instance. Valid values:

0: Service traffic forwarding is stopped.
1: Service traffic forwarding is normal
Enabled.description_zh:
实例的业务流量转发状态。取值：

0：表示已停止转发业务流量。
1：表示正常转发业务流量

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the instance. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: 实例的到期时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance

IpMode.description_en:
The IP forwarding mode of the instance. Valid values:

fnat: The IP versions of the origin server and the client are the same. Requests from IPv4 clients are forwarded to IPv4 origin servers, and requests from IPv6 clients are forwarded to IPv6 origin servers.
v6tov4: Requests from IPv6 clients are forwarded to IPv4 origin servers
IpMode.description_zh:
实例的IP转发模式。取值：

fnat：表示源站和客户端的IP版本一致，即IPv4地址客户端请求转发到IPv4地址源站、IPv6地址客户端请求转发到IPv6地址源站。
v6tov4：表示IPv6地址客户端请求转发到IPv4地址源站

IpVersion.description_en:
The IP protocol version of the instance. Valid values:

Ipv4: IPv4.
Ipv6: IPv6
IpVersion.description_zh:
实例的IP协议版本。取值：

Ipv4：表示IPv4协议。
Ipv6：表示IPv6协议

IsFirstOpenBw.description_en:
Indicates whether the 95th percentile burstable clean bandwidth metering method was enabled for the instance. Valid values:

0: No.
1: Yes
IsFirstOpenBw.description_zh:
实例是否开启过95弹性业务带宽计费模式。取值：

0：表示未开启过。
1：表示开启过

IsFirstOpenQps.description_en:
Indicates whether the 95th percentile burstable QPS metering method was enabled for the instance. Valid values:

0: No.
1: Yes
IsFirstOpenQps.description_zh:
实例是否开启过95弹性QPS计费模式。取值：

0：表示未开启过。
1：表示开启过

Status.description_en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

1: Normal.
2: Expired
Status.description_zh:
实例的状态。取值：

1：表示正常。
2：表示已过期

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances queried
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的DDoS高防实例的总数量
